Unit 3 Is Live!

June 11, 2026 · Chris O'Hara

This week: Unit 3 unlocks today! Dive into Market Intelligence & Competitive Strategy — learn how to transform CI from periodic review to living intelligence systems. Plus: the best CI resources on the site, two hands-on labs, and a look at our competitive agent in action.

🎓 Now Available

Take Unit 3: Market Intelligence & Competitive Strategy

The battlecard is dead. Long live the living intelligence system.

Unit 3 explores how AI is transforming competitive intelligence from a periodic, document-driven process into a continuous, agent-powered advantage. You'll learn from real SAP examples — including how Soo Shim built BattleCoach, the competitive AI assistant that's changing how teams prepare for deals.

What You'll Learn

  • From periodic to persistent: Transform CI from quarterly reviews to real-time monitoring
  • Census-level win/loss: Analyze every deal, not just a sample
  • The Living CI Architecture: Build systems that synthesize, not just collect
  • The practitioner's playbook: Step-by-step guide to agent-powered CI

⏱️ Time commitment: ~45 minutes

Start Unit 3 →
